history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration issue guidance to special political missions and peacekeeping missions that are funded by the regular budget to increase their focus on improving equitable geographical distribution.
history.administration_response: In February 2024, the Office of Human Resources presented to the Executive Officers relevant information on (a) the status of equitable geographical distribution; (b) the review of the performance of the Senior Manager’s Compact for 2023 and the importance of concerted efforts to reach compliance with the geographical targets in the 2024 Compact; and (c) the upcoming changes to the system of desirable ranges and emphasis on General Assembly resolution 77/278. In April 2024, the Assistant Secretary-General for Human Resources will be sending a communication to heads of entities emphasizing the urgency of bringing every Member State within its desirable range. In August 2023, the Office of Human Resources launched a careers outreach package to streamline and optimize global talent outreach efforts across the Secretariat’s entities. The package includes organizational strategies on gender parity and geographical representation, United Nations Careers- branded materials, talent outreach presentation slides, handouts for candidates and frequently asked questions. A session was held for all human resources practitioners. Given the above, the Administration considers the recommendation closed.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Office of Human Resources organized two sessions with special political missions and peacekeeping operations to provide relevant information on equitable geographical distribution, the Board considers this recommendation to be implemented.
